facts: Parties: Pemberton Logistics plc (Buyer), Pemberton Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Netherby Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 23 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 28 February 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.

Section 8.3 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $25,200,000. The Purchase Price is $210,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,650,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $209,300,000.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Fenwick Robotics Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $3,400,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
